Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words. I’m interested in this project and the proposed timeline/budget looks reasonable. A few quick questions to confirm scope so I can prepare a firm proposal:

1) Do you have API docs or a sandbox endpoint I can review (response shapes, auth method)?
2) How many distinct dashboard views / user roles do you expect (e.g., admin, read-only, team)?
3) Do you have sample data or an existing schema for the realtime streams (events/sec, typical payload size)?
4) Any firm requirements around the charting library (D3, Recharts, Chart.js) or are you open to recommendations for performance/scalability?
5) For auth, do you already have an identity provider (OAuth/OIDC, SSO) or should I include building role-based auth from scratch?
6) Are there any accessibility or compliance requirements we should factor in?

I’m available for a 30-minute call to walk through details — I can do tomorrow between 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00 CT, or Friday morning. Let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite. Once I review the API/docs and confirm roles/data, I’ll provide a detailed timeline and milestone-based quote.

Looking forward to it — Jordan
